lines.en: I stride along the floodplain.

lines.zh: 我的双冠在前头一晃一晃
lines.en: My twin crests bob as I go.

lines.zh: 我踩在湿泥上，脚印很深
lines.en: My prints sink deep in the wet mud.
I work along the waterline.
Fern fronds scrape along my back.
I glance back over my shoulder.
My tail swings to keep me steady.
At the first sound I turn that way.
I go around a shallow pool.
I walk out into the open.
My toes dig into the mud.
I come around a clump of brush.
I break into a short run.
I lift my head and taste the air.
I follow the dry channel.
I stop with one foot still raised.
I stand with my crests to the sun.
I tilt my head and listen a while.
The insects in the trees are a nuisance.
I open my mouth to shed heat, my tongue dry.

lines.zh: 我还记得水位高的时候
lines.en: I remember when the water was higher.
I work my jaws at nothing.
My breathing is nearly silent.
Something is wading across the river.
I have no intention of moving.
I shake my neck.
I hold myself up on my hind legs.
The sun is strong; I squint.
I have caught nothing.
It is suspiciously quiet.
You are looking at my crests.
I study you with my head tilted.
My crests are not for fighting.
Your hands smell of blood.
I step forward half a pace and stop.
Do not assume I am small.
My teeth are better known than my crests.

lines.zh: 我盯着你站在泥里的脚
lines.en: I watch your feet in the mud.
You do not blink, and neither do I.
I am deciding whether to bother with you.

lines.zh: 我被逼得往后挪了半步
lines.en: I am forced half a step back.
My crests are knocked crooked.
That one stung badly.
I snap my jaws shut.
My hind legs feel weak.
I back toward the ferns.

lines.zh: 我从喉里挤出一声尖叫
lines.en: I squeeze a shriek out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我的血在泥里淌成一条
lines.en: My blood runs in a line through the mud.
These legs can still run.
I have marked that bite.
This smells like it might go down.
I walk toward your hand.
Put that thing down.
I can tell it is meat.
This falls far short.
Let me bite first and think later.
Stop shaking, it makes me dizzy.
I lean in closer.
I chew faster than usual.
Give me a little more.
You ran right into my chest.
The bump shifts me half a pace.
Do not come this close.
My crest brushes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟压在我的趾上
lines.en: Your heel came down on my toes.
We both stop as we pass.
I turn and shove you aside with my flank.
That bump means nothing to me.
I roll my head about.
Move, I am walking on.

lines.zh: 我这样站着，她应该看得见
lines.en: Standing like this, she should see me.
The crests must be held high.
A shallow pool lies between us.
I turn my flank toward her.
I have practised this pose a long while.
She looked once, then left.
I follow her along the bank.
Neither of us makes a sound.
The ground here is flat enough.
We walk side by side along the bank.
I take whatever lies on the ground.
I snatch it and shake it twice.
This is not fresh.
I swallow it without chewing once.
I pin it with a foot.
Whosever it was, I eat it first.
It is stuck between my teeth.
This cannot be eaten at all.
I hide it in the ferns.
I sniff and walk away.
You walked into my hunting ground.
I raise my head to size you up.
My crests are up.
Your sweat fills my nostrils.
Once I mark you, you are mine.
I turn from the water.
You are far easier than fish.
I make the first move.
Back into the mud and you will be slow.
I have saved this bite.
I crouch, ready to break into a run.
Let me weigh what you are worth.
I tighten the circle bit by bit.
I inch toward you along the mud.
My crests stay pointed at you.
I am looking at your feet.
You shift a hand's width; I match it.
I track you and count your moves.
There is water at your back.
I have all the time in the world to outlast you.
The wind brings your scent.
I edge a little closer.
I will not call out this time.

lines.zh: 你听见泥里的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the mud?

lines.zh: 我在你身后的蕨丛里绕
lines.en: I circle through the ferns behind you.
I lunge hard.
My teeth sink into your calf.
The impact throws you back.
I whip my head round.
Blood spatters the mud.
I pull back for a second try.
That bite landed true.
You block the claws, not the teeth.
I bite and walk off.
You are still down.
That gash will last you a good while.
There is blood on my crests.

lines.zh: 我从河漫滩那头走过来
lines.en: I come from the far side of the floodplain.
I raise my head and show my crests.

lines.zh: 水边的泥地上多了一串脚印
lines.en: New prints appear in the waterside mud.
The water level here is just right.
First I checked the wind.
I push the ferns apart and step out.
My shadow falls on the shallow water.
I ease toward the water.

lines.zh: 这里安静，我可以慢慢找
lines.en: It is quiet, so I can hunt slowly.
I shake the water off me.
I have found a good hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我把脚放进泥里试了试
lines.en: I test the mud with one foot.
Morning light makes my crests stand out.
I came along the bank.
Fire singes my crests.
I tumble down the bank.
River water floods my lungs.
The blast throws me into the shallows.
An arrow bites into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 魔法一路烧进我的骨节
lines.en: Magic burns down into my joints.
My belly is empty and my legs tremble.
Lightning hits the waterside and I spring.
The mud is gone.
